implementation: Added colony-scoped ColonyShipBuildplan ownership (colonyId, indexes, FK migration) and scoped detail buildplans.
Added create/rename/delete/build-from-plan service methods and controller endpoints under /colonies/:id/buildplans.
Build-from-plan reuses existing buildShip validation/cost/crew/storage flow and writes queue snapshots independent of later plan delete/rename.
PanelShipyard now lists buildplans and supports use, rename, delete, and save-current-selection without page navigation.
Added Jest coverage for owner validation, empty/duplicate names, create/rename/delete, and build-from-plan queue snapshots surviving delete.

notes: Merged Social tab into Crew tab, kept Settings separate.

implementation: Demolition now refunds floor(half resourceCosts) into storage via ColonyStorageService, updates colony.storageUsed, and emits a BUILDING_DESTROYED action event with recycled commodities.
Building activation now fails fast on effective free workers, energy deficit, and missing negative non-saveable effect commodities such as orbital maintenance.
Manual deactivation/demolition now cascades to dependent consumer buildings when support effect production disappears.
Tick worker shortage deactivation now compares effective workers and keeps only supportable active buildings online.
Extended colony orbit DTO with ship class metadata, fleet grouping, local management flags, shuttle/station/defense blocker reasons, and top-level orbitBlockers summary.
Added Orbit tab UI with grouped orbit ships, direct land/disassemble actions, links into spacecraft UI, blockade visibility, and explicit disabled actions for defend/block/shuttle flows.
Kept existing hangar launch/land loop as the only shuttle-adjacent implementation and documented missing dedicated shuttle and station models instead of inventing new backend systems.
Added Jest coverage for orbit blocker metadata when only generic spacecraft models exist in colony orbit.
blockers: No dedicated shuttle entity or shuttle-specific management API exists beyond generic hangar launch/land flows.
No station entity is attached to colony orbit in the current SWU model.
No orbit defend/block endpoints or hooks exist yet; backend typecheck also remains blocked by pre-existing TS6138/TS6305/TS7006 errors outside this slice.
notes: backend:typecheck still fails after the slice on pre-existing unrelated diagnostics in faction and multiple spec declaration outputs; the slice-specific colony.service error introduced here was fixed before logging evidence.

implementation: Split colony feature-access mapping into fighter shipyard, core shipyard, repair shipyard, fabrication, and fabrication-support groups instead of folding all ids into one coarse bucket.
Shipyard tab access now includes fighter shipyard id 5 explicitly, while fabrication tab visibility also recognizes support functions 29 and 30.
Colony detail shipyard DTO now exposes fighterPresentFunctionIds/fighterActiveFunctionIds so the frontend can render all shipyard functions without losing the fighter-only building function.
Updated colony feature-access regression coverage and shipyard panel/frontend fixtures to match the refined mapping.

Colony scan returns only redacted surface intel: colony identity, owner name/id, object position/class, terrain/building presence/name/construction/active/integrity percent; storage, defense, population, production, events, and queues are explicitly omitted.

Extended database rankings with public colonyWorth and colonyProductionWorth rankings using building counts/active-building counts only, deterministic score/name ordering, no storage/defense/torpedo fields.
Visual/rotation/time kept as SWU-design follow-up: no colony mask/rotation fields added because current model has celestial surfaceWidth/surfaceHeight but no STU rotation factor.
